label: Concept illustration
alt: Animated cross-section of a synthetic scroll swept from cap to base in the scanner's fixed frame: the spiral of sheets turns and its winding center, a copper ring, drifts off the scanner's axes, while a side view at the same scale draws the center's track down the scroll.
caption: Concept illustration: a synthetic scroll swept from cap to base, its winding center marked in copper. Formulas only, no scan and no model run.
